measurement_scope: End-to-end localhost/Samba workload; two client processors, configured 384-MiB test heap and 256-MiB/one-CPU standalone peer with 64-MiB tmpfs share. Bind timings subtract the deliberate application-I/O gate interval; CPU/GC include the whole profile. Heap gauges include probe weak references, fingerprints and samples. This is not JMH, full allocation profiling, independent physical-NIC scaling or a throughput/durability comparison.
nonce_scope: Churn checks each prepared target-original-key binding MID once, actual original-key bytes, fresh bound-key bytes and unchanged encryption owner/key, with real peer/client mandatory verification. It does not independently recompute every churn MAC. Separate current-production public traces independently verify 4299 NTLM and 304 Kerberos signed inputs with zero observed distinct-message actual-key/nonce reuse.
cost_finding: Catch-up grows with binding history: five to 139 ECHOs per successful candidate in this 64-cycle workload; 5216 total per profile includes initial caller/companion and prepared failures. Constant catch-up and longer-history operational cost are not qualified.
